item.description:
Federal and local law enforcement agencies conducted 24 immigration arrests in Martin County on Tuesday, according to data kept by the Florida Department of Law Enforcement. The Martin County Sheriff's Office confirmed FDLE was the agency behind the arrests.

item.title: Methamphetamine surge hits Palm Beach County as cocaine prices rise
item.description: Federal agents in Palm Beach County seized about 54 kilos of crystal meth in just two days, part of what they call an unprecedented surge fueled by rising cocaine prices.

item.title: Port St. Lucie ranked 67th most stressed city in United States
item.description: Port St. Lucie ranked as the 67th most stressed city in the United States and 42nd most financially stressed, according to a new WalletHub study.

item.title: Port St. Lucie teen heading to FIFA World Cup finals after surprise announcement
item.description: Enrique Rosario Liz, a Port St. Lucie teenager named Youth of the Year for the Southeast Region of the Boys & Girls Clubs of America, will serve as a Coca-Cola flag bearer at the FIFA World Cup finals on July 19.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, has guided ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff in dramatic Wimbledon semifinal tiebreaker
item.description: Muchova won 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) to reach her second Grand Slam final and end Gauff's best Wimbledon run.

item.title: Women's Professional Baseball League unveils team names and logos ahead of August debut
item.description: The four-team league includes San Francisco Firebells, Los Angeles Queens, New York Heights, and Boston Hunters.

item.title: Park Vista Community High School football team targets state playoffs after strong 2025 finish
item.description: The Cobras won four of their last five games in 2025 and are working to carry that momentum through the entire 2026 season.

item.title: Florida back-to-school sales tax holiday runs July 20 through August 20
item.description: Florida families can save hundreds of dollars during the state's 32-day tax-free shopping period for school supplies, clothing, and computers.

item.title: Florida tax holiday exempts purchases at most retailers but excludes theme parks and airports
item.description: The state's back-to-school tax exemption applies to online shopping and layaway purchases but is not available at theme parks, hotels, or airports.

item.title: Port St. Lucie soccer stadium groundbreaking set for November at Walton & One development
item.description: Port St. Lucie SC released new renderings of its 6,000-seat stadium and announced groundbreaking is targeted for November at the Walton & One development.
